name: Sunny Cheeseman
source:
Has aspirations of being a singer or an actress.

Despite her young age, she's mature, responsible, and intelligent.

The kind of girl who studies hard, gets good grades, and is well-liked by her teachers.

Finds Blake irritating and self-obsessed, but tries her best to cheer him up - even if she has to suffer his endless tirades against the Hollywood actor Gerard Butler.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43275]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
